description:
Lightweight SQL Server data-access library for .NET 8, 9, and 10. Simplifies stored
			procedure execution, automatic SqlParameter caching, List-to-DataTable (TVP) conversion,
			multi-result mapping (SQLSPResultMapper, SQLMultipleResult), resiliency retry policies, performance monitoring, DI support, and Azure SQL Managed Identity authentication.
releaseNotes:
Release Notes - v2.0.6 (2026-11-26)

			✨ Major Features & Additions:

			1. Automatic Resilient Retry Policy (ISQLRetryPolicy & SQLRetryPolicy)
			- Configurable automatic retries for transient SQL Server and Azure SQL failures (Deadlocks 1205, timeouts -2, throttling, network drops, Azure failover).
			- Exponential backoff with customizable multiplier and randomized jitter (+/- 25%) to prevent synchronized retry storms.
			- Non-idempotent write safety guard: automatically aborts mid-execution write retries unless explicitly enabled or verified as rolled-back deadlocks.
			- Full CancellationToken propagation across database calls, bulk copy, transactions, readers, and retry backoff delays.

			2. SQL Query Performance Monitoring & Diagnostics (ISQLPerformanceMonitor)
			- Monotonic Stopwatch-based execution duration timing with zero allocation overhead.
			- Slow-query detection and structured logging with configurable thresholds.
			- Security-first parameter tracking: records parameter names while strictly excluding sensitive parameter values.
			- OpenTelemetry distributed tracing via ActivitySource ("SQLStoredProcedureCommandsFunctions").
			- Ambient correlation tracking via SQLCorrelationContext (AsyncLocal<string?> and Activity.Current fallback).

			3. Automatic Dependency Injection (AddSQLStoredProcedureFunctions)
			- Native IServiceCollection extension methods with options pattern (IOptions<SQLCommandsOptions>).
			- Scoped database executor (ISQLStoredProcedureExecutor) ensuring zero connection leaks and pooled per-request lifecycles.
			- Multi-database / named connection factory (ISQLStoredProcedureExecutorFactory).

			4. Advanced Stored Procedure Multi-Result Mapping (ExecuteMultipleAsync)
			- Direct streaming of complex multi-result stored procedures into strongly-typed POCO collections (IReadOnlyList<T>) with zero DataTable allocations.
			- Support for up to 5 generic result sets (SQLMultipleResult<T1, T2, ...>) with direct tuple deconstruction:
			  (IReadOnlyList<CustomerDto> customers, IReadOnlyList<OrderDto> orders, IReadOnlyList<AddressDto> addresses) = result;
			- Pre-computed property reflection and column-ordinal caching per result set.
			- Native support for Enums, Guids, Nullables, DateOnly, TimeOnly, and [MapFrom] attribute mappings.
			- Clear distinction between empty result sets and missing result sets (SQLMissingResultSetException).
			- Anonymous parameter object support: SQLParamHelper.ToSqlParameters(new { CustomerId = 1 }).

			5. Azure SQL Authentication & Managed Identity (AzureCredential)
			- Added AzureCredential helper with environment-aware token resolution and cancellation-aware async token acquisition (GetTokenAsync / GetToken).
			- Local development via VisualStudioCredential.
			- Cloud environments via DefaultAzureCredential / Managed Identity.
			- Automatic access token injection into SqlConnection instances.

			6. C# 12 & Modern Code Quality
			- Modernized to C# 12 primary constructors across all classes and record structs.
			- Clean, bracket-free single-line control flow syntax.
			- Standardized all APIs to uppercase SQL naming convention.
			- Target-typed new() and explicit typing across the entire codebase.
title: SQL Server Stored Procedure C# Mapping Utilities & Azure Managed Identity Helper
